mentions.name: 10Cups
mentions.description: NFC-based coffee shop loyalty system: customers who buy ten coffees receive an NFC sticker for their travel mug, and tapping it on a reader attached to the barista's Kitchen Display shows how they like their coffee and redeems one cup. Regulars skip the queue without loyalty apps, QR codes, or sign-ups. Integrated into the coffee shop POS.
mentions.problem: Loyalty programs require annoying apps, QR codes, or sign-ups, and regulars buying the same coffee every time waste time queuing and repeating their order.
mentions.audience: Coffee shop owners, baristas, and their regular customers
mentions.source_excerpt:
10Cups. We pretty much all buy the same type of coffee, every time. 
So I added a simple NFC reader to the barista's Kitchen Display.
You buy ten cups of coffee, they give you a NFC sticker for your travel mug.
Tomorrow, you skip the queue, hand the barista your travel mug.
They tap it on the reader, see how you like your coffee, and redeem one.
